scope: Complete currently accessible artist-provenance index from 197 explicit user score records, 35 earlier accepted original identities, 281-source acquired/research registry and 101 earlier editorial subject selections; NOT complete lifetime oeuvre for every artist.
rules: Numeric 5 = strongest direct positive; 4 = positive; 3 = potential scene image but NOT proof of global artist preference; 0–2 global exclusion of exactly that rated image and negative evidence of that specific composition, not a categorical artist ban.
Older accepted ORIGINAL art identities reflect previous approval, unnumbered; never infer 5/5 repeated-use eligibility.
101 earlier SELECTED editorial subject rows are contextual leads only, not automatically artist popularity votes or 5/5 human art ratings.
Do not merge atelier/follower/collaborator into attributed original artist; Caravaggio and Paolo Veronese identity name variants canonicalized only where same painter.
Hard exclusions: Fra Angelico, El Greco irrespective of older subject selections.
Explicit stylistic benchmark artists retain research priority even if the numeric sample is missing or conflicts on a single artwork, e.g. Rubens.
Previously acquired originals scored 4 or 5 are not to be resourced or re-presented; only acquisition upgrades for 3/5, unrated, or missing originals when worthwhile.
Globally rated 0–2 works cannot re-enter automatically even though 'at or below 3'; find different paintings by liked painters.
Numerical artist rank is confidence-limited when observations < 3; do not call a painter a universal favourite from one reviewed work.
Style popularity and image rights/resolution/technical crop are separate review gates.
